title: Configure Shelf
description: Configure Shelf. Optional properties that are not sent keep their current value.

host.description: Host name for the application, like 'shelf.domain.org'

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

disable_signup.title: Disable self-service sign-up
disable_signup.description: When true, nobody can create an account by signing up: users can only join by invitation.

mail_from.title: Sender e-mail address
mail_from.description: Address used as sender of the e-mails sent by Shelf. Empty means noreply@<host>.

maptiler_token.title: MapTiler API key
maptiler_token.description: Optional API key to draw maps. Empty removes the current key.
